newsitem.title: UK: Jarvis jumps after upbeat statement.
newsitem.headline: Jarvis jumps after upbeat statement.

text.p: Shares in Jarvis Plc rose in pre-market trading on Monday after an upbeat trading statement from the facilities management and construction group.
The stock was up 20-1/2p at 245 by 0716 GMT in volume of 25,000 shares.
In a brief statement, Jarvis said trading in the last six months had been stronger than previously budgeted.

"As a consequence of this, coupled with lower rationalisation costs than anticipated, the board is confident that the company's results for the fifteen month period ended March 31 1997 will substantially exceed current market expectations," Jarvis said.
